about: Concrete motifs a brief implies and what draws them. Each theme has keywords (whole words or phrases, accents ignored) and elements: the specific thing to draw, the placeholder it replaces, how to build it, and the catalog shapes, organic presets, object kinds and operations that do it. vixl_reference(brief) returns the matching themes as motifs; vixl_reference('motifs') returns them all.

elements.element: a cup or mug with steam rising from it
elements.instead_of: a plain disc, ring or circle standing in for the drink
elements.draw: shape cup (a mug on its saucer) with shape steam above the rim, about 0.6 of the cup's height and narrower than it; group them and declare object cup, naming body and steam as parts

elements.element: coffee beans or a pastry beside the cup
elements.instead_of: scattered dots
elements.draw: a few beans as shape lens (rotated, two tones) or an organic blob for a bun; three to five, not a pattern

elements.element: a warm window or lamp glow
elements.instead_of: a flat yellow rectangle
elements.draw: haze behind the lamp or window (form round for a lamp, band for a lit window row)

elements.element: filled layered water: bands of sea in three or four tones, lighter at the horizon, darker in front
elements.instead_of: thin stroked wave lines, which read as unfinished next to filled shapes
elements.draw: organic preset water across the lower part of the canvas (width = canvas width; params.tones in the brand's blues back to front, or params.color); it fills its box edge to edge

elements.element: a lighthouse standing in the sea, its base hidden behind the front band of water
elements.instead_of: a tower floating on a bar or platform in mid-air
elements.draw: shape lighthouse placed so its bottom sits inside the water; order it between the back and front water bands (reorder below the front band) so the sea overlaps its base

elements.element: a beam that fades into the distance from the lantern room
elements.instead_of: a hard-edged wedge or visible translucent bands
elements.draw: a pen wedge from the lantern with a gradient-overlay layer style running from the light colour to transparent, plus haze (form round) on the lantern itself

elements.element: lights reflected in the water
elements.instead_of: rows of short dashes
elements.draw: reflection with horizon at the waterline once the scene above it is drawn; re-run it with target after editing the scene

elements.element: still filled water with a mirrored shoreline
elements.instead_of: an empty flat band or a few wave lines
elements.draw: organic preset water with low amplitude (params.amplitude 0.02, crest false), then reflection of the shoreline, trees or buildings with ripple 0.15 and fade 0.5

elements.element: trees or reeds on the shore
elements.instead_of: green triangles
elements.draw: organic presets pine, tree or grass, smaller and lighter toward the far shore

market.title: Winter, night or holiday market and festivals

elements.element: strings of lights or paper lanterns sagging across the top, each with a glow
elements.instead_of: evenly spaced dots or circles on a straight line
elements.draw: string-lights from one edge to the other with a sag (bulb lantern for a lantern festival, globe for fairy lights; two strings at different depths, the back one smaller)

elements.element: market stalls with striped or scalloped awnings and a warm glow under them
elements.instead_of: plain rectangles
elements.draw: a rectangle stall with a scalloped-border or banner awning, haze (form band) under the awning

elements.element: snowfall or a starry sky that keeps clear of the copy
elements.instead_of: random dots over the text
elements.draw: star-field (white, sparkles 0 for snow) over the sky region; it keeps clear of every text layer by default

elements.element: lights reflected on wet ground or water
elements.instead_of: nothing below the horizon
elements.draw: reflection under the stalls or quay, or bokeh for out-of-focus lights in the foreground

elements.element: a skyline of varied buildings with irregular lit windows
elements.instead_of: a row of equal boxes (a placeholder skyline)
elements.draw: buildings of different widths and heights (rectangle, plus a few house or tower roofs), darker in front; windows as small rectangles repeated with repeat and some removed or dimmed so the pattern is irregular

elements.element: a sky with stars or a glow over the city
elements.instead_of: a flat dark fill
elements.draw: a vertical gradient sky, star-field in the upper part (it avoids the copy), and haze (form band) along the skyline for city glow

elements.element: lights reflected in a river or on wet streets, and out-of-focus lights
elements.instead_of: dashes under each window
elements.draw: reflection with the horizon at the waterline or street edge; bokeh in a foreground corner

elements.element: a moon with a soft halo
elements.instead_of: a flat disc on its own
elements.draw: shape moon or ellipse, with haze (form round) behind it

elements.element: stars of varied size with a few sparkles, thinning toward the horizon
elements.instead_of: evenly spread identical dots, or stars on top of the text
elements.draw: star-field over the sky region (fade 0.5 thins it toward the horizon; it keeps clear of every text layer)

music.title: Concert, open mic or club night

elements.element: a stage light or spotlight glow falling on the subject
elements.instead_of: decorative wave lines filling empty space
elements.draw: haze (form round) above the subject, string-lights across the top for a café or bar venue, bokeh for a crowd of lights

elements.element: an instrument or microphone drawn as an object with its parts
elements.instead_of: a single silhouette with clipped or mismatched parts
elements.draw: build it from parts (capsule and rounded-rectangle for a microphone; the guitar, piano or drum kinds list their parts) and declare it as an object
